## Palantir Surges ~7.9% as Maven AI Defense Revenue Surges and Guidance Raised

Palantir's Maven AI revenue surge with an accompanying guidance raise is the most direct confirmation yet that defense AI monetization is real, scalable, and accelerating; this is the clearest read-through for the portfolio's broader defense-tech and sovereign AI theses.

- Palantir (PLTR) stock rose approximately 7.9%
- Maven AI defense revenue surged, driving the upside
- Company raised guidance alongside the results
- Confirms that defense AI spending is translating into measurable, growing revenue with an upward revision — not just backlog
